item.title: After Xi Purges China’s Generals, a Military Inquisitor Rises

item.media:description: Zhang Shengmin, the vice chairman of the Central Military Commission, at a meeting in Beijing on Thursday. He was recently promoted to the Politburo, the Communist Party’s top leadership council.

item.title: Howard Lutnick Took Softer Line on Nvidia as Calls for Tougher Controls Grew
item.description: Critics say Howard Lutnick, the commerce secretary, and his department have shielded Nvidia as concerns have grown over A.I. chip sales to firms like Megaspeed.
item.dc:creator: Ana Swanson, Tripp Mickle, Maggie Haberman and Jonathan Swan
item.media:description: Howard Lutnick has frequently clashed with top officials over how to regulate sales of advanced technology to Asia, particularly Nvidia’s chip sales in the region.

item.title: Nvidia Scandal Unleashes a Flood of AI-Generated Memes
item.description: The revelations surrounding Jensen Huang, who resigned from Nvidia over extramarital affairs, inspired social media posts using the very technology his company helped develop.
item.dc:creator: Zane Irwin
item.media:description: Jensen Huang resigned from the company he co-founded, the board announced on Thursday.

item.title: When Bernice Gottlieb Visited a Community of People With Leprosy
